data.text:
There is a price for everything.

Coffee. Cocoa. Sugar. Beef. 

The things that feed the world, fuel economies, and sit at the center of trade routes that have existed for centuries.

But ask a Web3 builder to access those prices onchain six months ago and they would laugh at you. 

Or cry.

Depends on the builder.

That gap always bothered me.
Because I know what it means when a developer in Lagos or Manila or Nairobi cannot build around the prices that actually move their local economy.

It means the tools keep getting built for someone else. Again.

The same someone else. Every time.

Then @PythNetwork moved.

Four new feeds.
Cocoa.
Coffee.
Raw Sugar.
Live Cattle.

Quietly dropped into the Pyth Pro catalog like it was nothing, but if you understand what that actually means, you stopped scrolling.

These are not random assets.

These are the commodities that dominate trade across Africa, Southeast Asia, and Latin America.

The crops people plant, harvest, and pray over. The livestock entire regional economies are built around.

And now their prices are live, real, institutional grade and are also accessible onchain. 

Accessible to anyone.
No Bloomberg terminal.
No legacy vendor contract.
No toll booth.

Just the price.
Clean.
Available.
Programmable.

Pyth sits at 3,000+ feeds now. Crypto, equities, FX, metals, energy, and now the soft commodities and livestock that the rest of DeFi forgot existed.

All under one API.
One subscription.
https://t.co/8rEjuyiMNW

The timing is not an accident either.

Tariffs are rewriting trade routes. Climate is hitting harvests in ways the models did not predict.

Supply chains that everyone assumed were stable are showing just how fragile they always were. In that environment, soft commodities and livestock are some of the most actively traded contracts on the planet.

And builders in Web3 can now touch them.

Prediction markets priced in cocoa. Perpetual exchanges running on coffee futures. Structured products built around cattle; the same way others build around BTC.

The infrastructure is here.

The only question is who builds first.

That is the invitation sitting inside this announcement.

The price of everything is coming onchain.

One feed at a time.💡
